simple.meaning: מִרְקַחַת (mirqachath) is a Hebrew object word meaning “an aromatic unguent ; also an unguent-pot.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Exodus 30:25. The surrounding context includes family line, priesthood, city.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מִרְקַחַת (H4842) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
